title: Compact-support exchange intertwines proper ordinary counits
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum and the geometric operation datum of [def-sf-kv-maps], at $A=A_{E,n}$. Work on the bounded constructible finite-Tor categories $D^b_{ctf}(-,A)$, with their specified ordinary adjunctions $Lu^*\dashv Ru_*$ and counits $\varepsilon_u$ of [fix-prop-adjunctions](1), compact-support composition of [thm-sf-comp-composition], and the proper identifications $Ru_!\cong Ru_*$ of [prop-functor-package](3). Use the compact-support exchange of [def-exchange-projection], with the choice-independent normalization of [fix-lem-exchanges]. Let $W,U,V,V'$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and let
$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
 V'&\xrightarrow{\beta'}&U\\
 {\scriptstyle\alpha'}\downarrow&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle\alpha}\\
 V&\xrightarrow{\beta}&W
\end{array}
$$
be Cartesian, with all arrows separated of finite type and $\alpha$ proper (hence $\alpha'$ proper). No properness is required of $\beta$ or $\beta'$. Write
$$T:L\alpha^*R\beta_!\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}_!}R\beta'_!L\alpha'^*$$
for the specified exchange, and let
$$\Theta:R\beta_!R\alpha'_*\cong R\beta_!R\alpha'_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(\beta\alpha')_!=R(\alpha\beta')_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R\alpha_!R\beta'_!\cong R\alpha_*R\beta'_!$$
be the specified compact-support composition comparison. For every $Z\in D^b_{ctf}(V',A)$ one has
$$\varepsilon_{\alpha,R\beta'_!Z}\circ L\alpha^*(\Theta_Z)
=R\beta'_!(\varepsilon_{\alpha',Z})\circ T_{R\alpha'_*Z}$$
as maps $L\alpha^*R\beta_!R\alpha'_*Z\longrightarrow R\beta'_!Z$. All functors, proper comparisons and composition comparisons in this equality are the named geometric ones on the stated finite-coefficient domains.
